nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking balances, mutated by unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender], read/written in transferFrom and approve without SafeMath.
Public total token supply set in the constructor from the _supply argument.
Private owner address set to msg.sender at construction; used as the sole access control for delegate and batchSend.
Public token name string, set in the constructor from user-supplied input.
Public token symbol string, set in the constructor from user-supplied input.
Public constant decimals (18) exposed as a state variable.
Hardcoded internal constant router address 0x7a250d...488D, also whitelisted as owner's spender.
payable transfer(address,uint) that simply forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier, performing raw unchecked balanceOf/allowance mutations.
payable approve(address,uint) that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any checks.
payable delegate(address,bytes) that performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address.
payable owner-only batchSend looping over _tos, crediting _value to each recipient but only emitting half-value events.
payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balances and an infinite UNI allowance.
Modifier on transferFrom requiring _from == owner || _to == owner || _from == computed UNI pair.
internal pure helper computing a Uniswap-style pair address via keccak256 of factory/token hashes.
msg.sender in transfer, used as the _from argument of transferFrom.
msg.sender in transferFrom, used for allowance authorization and spender deduction.
msg.sender in approve, becomes the allowance owner entry.
msg.sender in delegate, compared to owner to gate the delegatecall.
msg.sender in batchSend, compared to owner and used as the debited balance holder.
msg.sender in the constructor, assigned to owner and given the entire supply.
a.delegatecall(b) with attacker-influenced target and calldata, return value ignored.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= and balanceOf +=/-= arithmetic without SafeMath.
Unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication, balance subtraction, and duplicate half-value emits.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is an argument of transfer and has no independent semantics.
_value is an argument of transfer and has no independent semantics.
_from is an argument of transferFrom used only for lookups.
_to is an argument of transferFrom used only for lookups.
_value is an argument of transferFrom used only in the arithmetic.
_spender is an argument of approve and carries no separate meaning.
_value is the allowance value written by approve.

Calldata b is the direct delegatecall payload and is subsumed by the unsafe operation.
_tos array is iterated by batchSend and has no standalone semantics.
_value is the per-recipient amount used by batchSend.
_name is directly assigned to the name state variable by the constructor.
_symbol is directly assigned to the symbol state variable by the constructor.
_supply is directly assigned to totalSupply by the constructor.
